description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController with endpoints for a welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller handling basic endpoints such as welcome, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info for the project.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a greeting message indicating the application is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects the user to the Swagger UI documentation page, preserving the original request's scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns the application's health status as 'OK'.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns basic information about the Spring Boot application.
